component.name: eParna
component.summary: A fast, lightweight, cross-platform ebook reader

description.p: eParna is a fast, lightweight, cross-platform desktop ebook reader written in pure Rust. The name comes from Sanskrit parṇa — "leaf" — so eParna is literally an "e-leaf": a light, quiet place to read.

ul.li: EPUB 2/3, Kobo KEPUB, and Open eBook (OEB/OPF)
FictionBook 2, Microsoft Reader LIT, PalmDB (PDB/PMLZ), Rocket eBook (RB), and Psion TCR
PDF, ODT, DOCX, PPTX, and Rich Text Format (RTF)
HTML/HTMLZ, Plain text/TXTZ, Markdown, Typst, AsciiDoc, Org-mode, reStructuredText, and LaTeX

description.p: Features include a library with cover thumbnails and deduplication, table of contents with deep search, bookmarks, notes, full-text and regex search, light/dark/sepia/OLED themes, typography controls, footnotes, dictionary and Wikipedia lookup, OPDS catalog support, 21+ format conversion, lossless EPUB 3 optimization, and a built-in book validator.
Reading is fully offline. The only network requests are ones you explicitly trigger.

Upgraded to ebook-rs 0.20.0 (pure Rust, zero C zstd dependency), fixed custom GPUI renderer cross-paragraph text selection, moved heavy I/O (book opening, cover backfill, exports, EPUB optimization) to background threads, and added a floating selection toolbar, Command Palette (Ctrl+K), drag-and-drop opening, paged stepping, exact mid-chapter scroll restore, EPUB 3 Landmarks, code syntax highlighting, W3C Web Annotation/WebPub/Readium Search JSON exports, and missing-file relinking.

Added OS built-in Text-to-Speech (TTS) with speed control, an interactive chapter-tick reading progress scrubber with live intra-chapter scroll tracking, About eParna dialog in Library view, 3 MiB cover caching with backfill, and fixes for typeface/alignment/custom-theme/keyboard navigation and modals.

Added a custom full-fidelity EbookDomTree-to-GPUI renderer with native CSS box borders, padding, margins, alignment, tables, lists, cross-block text selection, and clickable footnotes/images; upgraded ebook-rs to 0.19.3 with InlinedStyle CSS inlining and Microsoft Reader (.lit) export support.

Upgraded to ebook-rs 0.19.0 with 25+ input formats, categorized 21+ format export (plus RAG JSON), lossless EPUB 3 optimization, richer book analytics, and a redesigned reader UI with collapsible sidebar, floating typography/actions popovers, 1-click theme swatches, and click-anywhere library cards.
Switched to gpui-fast and gpui-kit 0.9.0 architecture for optimized layout and GPU-accelerated rendering, updated dependencies across the entire graph, and hardened security advisories.
Zen mode, navigation history, OLED Black theme, persistent bookmarks, plain text and Amazon KFX export, academic citations, and new application icon.
Enables PDF support and wires up more of the ebook-rs API: regex search, deep TOC search, richer book metadata, validation, cover thumbnails, library deduplication and EPUB conversion.
